description: BestBudget on your home screen, in its own window without browser controls.
iosSafari: In Safari, open the Share menu, choose Add to Home Screen, then confirm.
iosOther: On iOS 16.4 or later, open your browser’s Share menu and choose Add to Home Screen. If the option is missing, open this site in Safari.
browser: In your browser menu, choose Install BestBudget or Add to Home Screen. If unavailable, open the site over HTTPS in Chrome, Edge or Safari. In Chrome and Edge, the install button becomes available when the browser allows installation.
